long_biography.plain_text:
Blackmore joined the family business as a teenager and entered its board in his late twenties. In 1975 he took charge of the natural-health company founded by his father, Maurice. He carried its vitamin and herbal-supplement business into Asia and oversaw its stock-market listing a decade later. He remained its defining executive leader for decades, including service as executive chairman until 2017.

He stepped down as executive director three years later. When Kirin subsequently acquired Blackmores, Blackmore's 18 per cent holding formed the largest individual stake supporting the transaction. He has since focused on the Blackmore Family Foundation, backing university research and education in complementary medicine as well as leadership training.
